core.title: Oversized Padlockable Barrel Bolt, Global GH-832BB5-GV

text.description_html:
Global GH-832BB5-GV, Heavy Duty Padlockable Barrel Bolt

Extra large, the Padlockable Barrel Bolt is ideal for locking up your shed, warehouse, and other heavy duty, important doors where a regularly sized barrel bolt just won't do. The Oversized Barrel Bolt has a massive 9/16 inch diameter bolt for extra security. The zinc plating is for rust resistance. Due to its heavy duty construction, it is great for harsh conditions. It comes packaged with the necessary mounting hardware.

Also Available: Oversized 8 Inch Padlockable Barrel Bolt

Features and Specifications of the Extra Large Zinc Barrel Bolt:

  • Finish: Zinc Plated
  • Overall Length with Guide: 6-1/4"
  • Bolt Throw: 2"
  • Bolt Diameter: 9/16"
  • Mounting Plate Length: 4-1/2"
  • Mounting Plate Width: 2-12/16"
  • Overall Bolt Length: 5-1/2"
  • Guide Length: 2-11/16"
  • Guide Width: 1-1/2"
  • Guide Projection: 1"
  • Rust Resistant
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
